name: fynn-mods
description: Fynn's daily-driver Claude Code mods: an animated mascot, usage-limit bars, a pre-send sidekick, quick replies, a to-do worklist and a cost ledger.

plugins.name: clawd-buddy
plugins.description: Animated pixel mascot Clawd above the prompt: reacts to Claude's work, waiting times, idle time, time of day, the mouse and a mood that builds up over the session.

plugins.name: limit-bars
plugins.description: Bars for the 5-hour and weekly usage limits above the prompt, plus a ring showing how long the prompt cache stays warm. Cache guard: asks before an expensive cold send; /cache, /handoff, /keepwarm.

plugins.name: sidekick
plugins.description: Checks your message before it is sent, by rules and, where worthwhile, briefly with Sonnet: a hint line under your message or a question (new chat with handoff, a skill, a clearer version, or "wrong chat?" when the message belongs to another project). Names due maintenance once per chat (/skill-doctor, prompt-audit, consolidate-memory, /init). /savings shows cost per model and measurable savings.

plugins.name: quick-replies
plugins.description: Claude Code's own next-message suggestion as a button above Clawd; click it or type 1 in the empty prompt to send it. With /replies more on, up to three more suggestions from a fork of the session.

plugins.name: worklist
plugins.description: To-do sidebar next to the chat: queue tasks, even while Claude is working. When Claude is clearly done, the to-do is checked off and the next one starts; otherwise the list pauses with a reason and buttons. History per project. /todo

plugins.name: cost-ledger
plugins.description: Cost ledger across all chats: after every answer it records the chat cost (as /cost), tokens per model and model calls made by other mods. /ledger shows today, 7 and 30 days, total, history by model (days or weeks), projects and the most expensive chats. Observer only, no model calls.
